extName.description: The extension's name. A proper noun — leave it as it is in every locale.

extDescription.message: Read manga on the sites you already use, in a clean reader, and keep one library across your devices.
extDescription.description: The one-line description shown in the Chrome Web Store and on chrome://extensions.

commandToggleReader.message: Show or hide the reader on this page
commandToggleReader.description: What Alt+R does, as listed on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

actionUse.description: Button that copies what a tracker holds into the form being filled in.

placeholderNone.description: Stands in for an empty field. Lower case: it sits greyed out inside an input, not on a label.

chipNone.description: The chip that clears a choice — no language, no date, no score. A button, so it is capitalised where placeholderNone is not.

untitled.description: Shown where a series title should be but the page gave none.

signedInAs.description: Followed by the account's email address, in bold, on the same line.

syncOffline.message: Could not reach PanelFlow. Nothing is lost: this device will send its changes at the next sync.

syncIncomplete.message: Sync incomplete: some changes could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

sessionExpired.message: Your session has ended (the password was changed, or you were signed out elsewhere). Sign in again to resume syncing.

sessionDeleted.message: This account no longer exists. Its data has been removed from this device.

accountDeleted.message: Account deleted. Its data has been erased from our servers and from this device.

logoutKept.message: Signed out. The server could not be reached, so this account's library stays on this device and will be sent the next time you sign in with this account.

modeToastVertical.description: Flashed for a moment when the reader opens, so the reading direction is known before the first tap.

actionForgotPassword.description: Link under the sign-in buttons. It opens the web app, where the reset form lives.

optionsLanguageAuto.description: First entry in the language picker. The other entries are language names, written in their own language, and are not translated.

optionsLanguageHint.message: Applies to the popup, the reader and this page. Pages already open keep the old language until they are reloaded.

optionsOpenInApp.message: Open these settings in the PanelFlow app →

optionsBackendHint.message: Detection rules, library sync and progress sync are served from here. Point it at http://localhost:8787 to work against a backend of your own.
optionsBackendHint.description: Carries a <code> element. Keep the tag and the address inside it unchanged.

optionsThemeHint.message: Follows your account: change it here and the website and the phone app change too. With “Follow the system”, each device takes the theme of the machine it runs on. The reader has its own setting below.

mobileThemeHint.message: Follows your account: change it here and it changes on your other devices too. With “Follow the system”, each device follows its own setting. The reader has its own, in Settings › Reader.

optionsReaderHint.message: Alt+R shows or hides the reader on any detected page. Brightness, page gap and strip width are set in the reader itself, on the open chapter.

optionsAutoShow.message: Open the reader by itself on a chapter page
optionsAutoShow.description: The global default. The toolbar popup can override it for one site.

optionsAutoNext.message: Go on to the next chapter at the end of one

optionsHideRead.message: Hide chapters already read from the chapter list

optionsReaderDark.message: Keep the reader dark, whatever the theme
optionsReaderDark.description: On by default. Off hands the reader to the system's light/dark setting.

optionsTapSides.message: On either third of the screen

optionsTapHint.message: Narrow edges are for reading with a finger on the screen, where a tap in the middle is usually meant for the panel and not for turning the page.

optionsUpdatesHint.message: Only while the browser is open. The server keeps watching the sites it can reach and passes what it found to the extension, so checking rarely misses little.

optionsAllSites.message: Let PanelFlow run on every site

optionsAllSitesLead.message: Recommended: turn this on so PanelFlow works on as many sites as possible.

optionsAllSitesOn.message: On: PanelFlow works on every site you read on.

popupAllSitesTip.message: For PanelFlow to work on the most sites, turn on “all sites” in the settings.
popupAllSitesTip.description: Popup: a line under the page actions while the all-sites permission is off. Opens the settings on that switch.

welcomeAllSitesTitle.message: For PanelFlow to work on the most sites

welcomeAllSitesBody.message: Allow it on all sites. Without that, it only runs on the sites it already knows, and you turn it on site by site. You can change your mind in the settings.

optionsAllSitesHint.message: Without it, PanelFlow only runs on the sites it already knows, and the others are turned on one by one from the toolbar. With it, PanelFlow works wherever you read, covers and chapter downloads included, which often come from another domain. Chrome asks you to confirm.

optionsGrantedTitle.message: Sites you turned on from the toolbar:

optionsGrantedRefused.message: Chrome did not turn that site off. Try again from chrome://extensions.

optionsWhitelistLabel.message: Whitelisted domains, one per line (no ad blocking there)

optionsAdblockHint.message: The filter list ships with the extension, then updates from the server without an extension update. Whitelisting a domain covers its subdomains too.

optionsReplayHint.message: Lost? Run the setup again: pinning the button, when the reader opens, and the account.
optionsReplayHint.description: Carries the link that reopens the setup tour. Keep the <a> element and its id exactly as they are; translate only the words.

welcomeStep1Lede.message: Chrome hides new extensions behind the puzzle-piece icon. Click it, then click the pin next to PanelFlow.

welcomeStep1Hint.message: That button opens your library, your reading statistics and the list of sites. The reader also opens with <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> on any page.
welcomeStep1Hint.description: Carries two <kbd> elements around the shortcut. Keep the tags; the keys themselves are the same on every keyboard this ships to.

welcomeThemeHint.message: The page changes as you choose. Your account keeps this setting, so the website and the mobile app will look the same.

welcomeStep2Lede.message: PanelFlow works out whether the page you are on is a chapter. You decide what happens next, and you can change it site by site from the toolbar button.

welcomeAutoOnBody.message: You arrive on a chapter, and the reader is already open.

welcomeAutoOffBody.message: A small “📖 Reader Mode” button appears on chapters: one click, or <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd>, opens the reader. Otherwise the page stays as it is.
welcomeAutoOffBody.description: Carries two <kbd> elements around the shortcut.

welcomeDirectionHint.message: A site that declares its own direction takes priority, and any change you make inside the reader is remembered.

welcomeStep3Title.message: An account, if you want one

welcomeLibraryFollows.description: Finishes the sentence begun by signedInAs and the email in bold — it starts with a full stop on purpose.

welcomeStep4Lede.message: PanelFlow has no catalogue of its own: it reads the site you are already on. Go to the reading sites you normally use and open a chapter.

welcomeStep4Lede2.message: If it is recognised, the reader opens or the PanelFlow button appears on the page: you will know straight away whether a site works. <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> opens it at any time too.

welcomeStep4Hint.message: Support is not a fixed list: PanelFlow recognises most sites on its own and ships tuned rules for the main ones. If a site is not detected, report it from the extension menu.

authNoAnswer.message: PanelFlow could not be reached. Check your connection, then try again.

popupGroupRecentWatched.description: Same group as popupGroupRecent when everything in it is an anime — you watch an anime, you read a manga.

popupGroupWebtoons.description: A shelf of everything filed as a webtoon.

popupUnreadTitle.message: Only series with a chapter you have not read

popupLibraryEmpty.message: Nothing yet. Add entries to your library from any compatible site.

webSitesUnavailable.message: Your starred sites could not be loaded right now. The sites from your library are still listed.

popupSitesLede.message: The sites your library comes from, and the ones you starred. PanelFlow works on any site: open a chapter and it offers its reader.

popupIntroWhat.message: PanelFlow spots chapters on reading sites and opens them in a reader of its own: one set of controls, whatever the site looks like.

popupIntroWhere.message: On a chapter page the reader button appears on the page itself, and <kbd>Alt+R</kbd> opens it from anywhere. This window is the PanelFlow icon in the toolbar: pin it and it stays there.
popupIntroWhere.description: Keep the <kbd> element around the shortcut; translate only the words.

popupBadgeInLibrary.description: On a site in the compatible-sites list: it is only there because the user follows a series from it.

popupNoAccountBody.message: Your library is on this computer only, and new chapters are not being watched for while Chrome is closed. An account fixes both.

standUnread.message: Not caught up: there is something here to read

pageStateNoTab.message: No page in front. Open a chapter first.

pageStateScheme.message: PanelFlow does not run on browser pages.

pageStateUnreachable.message: PanelFlow has not loaded on this tab. Reload it.

pageStateUndetected.message: No chapter recognised on this page. You can still add the series.

pageStateUngranted.message: PanelFlow does not run on this site yet. Turn it on here.

pageStateOwnSite.message: This is PanelFlow’s own site: your library is right here.

chapterBadge.description: The chapter number on a library tile. $1 is the number. Tight on space — no room for a long word.

chapterN.description: A chapter by number, with room around it. $1 is the number, or an em dash when nothing has been read.

chaptersShort.description: How many chapters a tracker has recorded. $1 is the count.

sinceDate.description: When a tracker says the series was started. $1 is a date.

actionReadChapter.description: Tooltip on a cover that opens a chapter never read before. $1 is the chapter label.

actionContinueChapter.description: Tooltip on a cover that resumes where reading stopped. $1 is the chapter label.

badgeNewChapter.description: Badge on a tile with an unread chapter. $1 is the chapter label.

badgeNew.description: The same badge when the chapter has no label to show.

durationHours.description: A duration over an hour. $1 is whole hours, $2 is minutes padded to two digits.

toastNotReadable.message: Not a readable page. Reload it and retry.

toastWakingUp.message: The extension is still waking up. Try again.

toastBackendDown.message: $1 is not responding. Check the API URL in the settings.

trackerConnectedAs.description: $1 is the username on the tracker.

trackerPasswordAuth.message: Asks for a password rather than a permission page: not supported

trackerImportPending.description: Second press of the import button. $1 is how many series would be added, $2 how many would be filled in.

trackerUpToChapter.description: Tacked onto a linked series' line. $1 is the last chapter the tracker holds.

trackerNothingMissing.message: $1 has nothing this library is missing

trackerImportPreview.message: $1 to add · $2 to fill in. Press again to confirm
trackerImportPreview.description: What a dry-run import found. Nothing has been written yet.

trackerNotListening.message: · nothing is sent to it yet
trackerNotListening.description: Tacked onto "Connected" for a service PanelFlow can sign in to but cannot push progress to.

trackerRefusing.description: $1 is the tracker's own words. A push happens while you read, so this is the only place it is ever said.

trackerFetchedAhead.message: $1 brought up to date · $2 further along there than here
trackerFetchedAhead.description: $2 series the tracker has read more of than PanelFlow knows about. Nothing was changed for them: a tracker counts chapters and a bookmark is a page on a site.

statsLoadError.message: Statistics could not be loaded: $1. What you read on this device is kept below.
statsLoadError.description: $1 is the error the server or the network gave.

statsLocalOnly.message: Counted on this device. With an account, every device you read on adds up, and the history goes beyond the last few thousand chapters.

statAverageOfN.description: $1 is how many entries carry a score.

statDays.description: A streak length. $1 is a number of days.

reportWhatWentWrong.description: The line left for the user to answer in a new GitHub issue. Everything else in the issue stays English so it can be triaged.

readerLoadingChapter.description: Over the reader while it fetches another chapter of the same series. The pages stay on screen behind it — the reader no longer closes to change chapter.

readerNeedsAccess.message: PanelFlow is not allowed to read the pages from $1. Grant it in the settings to download this chapter.

readerHiddenOne.description: Why the chapter wheel is short. $1 is always 1 here; the many form is a separate key.

readerHelpTap.message: Tap a side to turn the page, the middle for the controls (a long strip scrolls instead)
readerHelpTap.description: One line of the help list. The <b> marks the gesture being named.

readerHelpPinch.message: Pinch or ctrl+wheel to zoom, drag to move: the view stays where you put it

readerHelpDoubleTap.message: Double tap to zoom in on a panel, again to fit the page

readerHelpArrows.message: ← → space turn the page · ↑ ↓ scroll the long strip

readerHelpWheel.message: C opens the chapter wheel: scroll or ↑ ↓ to pick one, enter to open it
readerHelpWheel.description: The letter keys are the shortcuts themselves and do not change with the language.

readerHelpKeys1.message: S preferences · B break the first page · 0 reset zoom

readerHelpKeys2.message: F full screen · H hide the controls · ? this list · Esc close

readerHelpNote.message: Reading direction, tap zones and everything else are in the settings.

readerResetDefaults.description: Button at the bottom of the reader’s settings panel. Puts every slider and switch back to what it shipped as; leaves the reading mode alone, because that one is remembered per series.

readerHelpToggleChrome.message: Tap the middle of the page to hide the controls, and again to bring them back.
readerHelpToggleChrome.description: In the reader’s help panel, on a phone only. Replaces the four lines about a keyboard and a mouse wheel, which describe a machine the reader is not holding.

readerSeriesPrefs.description: A switch above the reading mode. Off, the panel edits the settings every series opens with; on, it edits this series only.

readerSeriesOn.message: These settings now follow this series

readerEndOf.description: $1 is the chapter label as the site wrote it — "Chapter 42", "42.5".

readerEndCaughtUp.message: That is the newest chapter here.

readerEndLeftOne.description: How many chapters this site still lists after this one — not how many the series has.

pillReaderModeTitle.message: PanelFlow: open this chapter in Reader Mode

pillAddAnime.description: The button on an episode page. Opens the same library sheet a chapter page does — including the tracker rows.

pillHideControls.description: Folds the speed bar into a dot. A control you cannot get back is a control you uninstall the extension to be rid of, so this never fully disappears.

pillShowControls.description: The dot the bar folds into, and the way back.

modalSameTitleLead.message: You already follow this series on another site.

modalLikelyLead.message: This looks like a series you already follow.

modalCloseTitlesWarning.message: The titles are close but not identical. Check this is really the same series before migrating.

modalKeepsProgress.message: Your progress, score, notes and tags

modalKeepsOldSite.message: The old site, kept in the entry’s history

modalAddTagHint.message: Add a tag and press Enter

modalLocalOnlyHint.message: Saved on this device only. Sign in from the PanelFlow extension settings to see it in the web app.

modalConnectTrackerLead.message: Connect a tracker to fill this in from your own list:

modalConnectTrackerHint.message: Connect AniList or MyAnimeList in the PanelFlow web app to fill this in from your own list.

modalTrackerPickSeries.message: $1 does not know this title. Pick the right series:

modalNoTitle.message: Could not read a title on this page.

offlineEmpty.message: Nothing saved yet. Open a chapter, then press 📥 in the reader's side bar to keep it on this device.
offlineEmpty.description: Carries a <code> around the button's icon. Keep the tag and the icon.

offlineUsage.message: $1 · $2 on this device · kept for $3 days
offlineUsage.description: $1 is a chapter count already worded, $2 a size such as “12 MB”, $3 a number of days.

notifyNewChapterBody.description: $1 is the series title, $2 the chapter number, $3 the site it appeared on.

webForgotLede.message: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.

webImportTitle.message: Import a list from AniList or MyAnimeList

webExportTitle.message: Download a backup, or restore one

webMoveSiteTitle.message: Move every series off a dead site

webLibraryEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Add a series, or pin one from the PanelFlow extension while browsing your favorite manga site.

webCheckUpdatesTitle.message: Re-scan every series for new chapters

webUpdatesEmpty.message: Nothing new. Every series you are following is read up to its latest chapter.

webStatsEmpty.message: Nothing read yet. Reader Mode in the extension records reading time as you go.

webTrackersLede.message: Every chapter you finish is sent to the accounts below. PanelFlow only ever writes the chapter count, and only ever forwards.

webNoLinksYet.message: Nothing linked yet. A series finds itself on the tracker the first time you read a chapter of it.

webThemeHint.message: Follows your account: change it here and the extension and the phone app change too. If your computer and your phone should not share a theme at the same hour, pick “Follow the system”: each device then takes its own machine’s.

webLanguageHint.message: Follows your account, and applies here as much as in the extension and the phone app.

webAccountHint.message: Your library, your progress and your trackers follow this address.

webPasswordHint.message: We send a link to your address, and the link is what changes the password, so a browser someone else left signed in cannot change it.

webNoExtension.message: These settings live in the PanelFlow extension, which this browser does not have. Install it and this section fills in.

webReadingDirectionHint.message: How a chapter opens, unless the site says otherwise.

webCheckEveryHint.message: How often the extension looks, in the background.

webWhitelistHint.message: One domain per line. Ads are not blocked on these, for sites that break when they are.

webImportLede.message: Adds what is missing and fills in blanks. Nothing already in your library is overwritten.

webFromConnected.message: From an account you have connected:

webExportLede.message: The backup holds everything (shelves, bookmarks and reading history), and is the only format that can be restored here.

webRestoreLede.message: Fills in what is missing. Nothing already in your library is overwritten.

webShelvesLede.message: A shelf is a tab of your own. It still counts as one of the five reading statuses: that decides whether PanelFlow watches those series for new chapters, and what they export as.

webForgotSent.message: If that address has an account, a link is on its way.

webLinkOnItsWay.message: A link is on its way to your inbox.

webPasswordChanged.message: Password changed. Sign in with your new one.

webChaptersAhead.message: The latest chapter is $1 ahead of your bookmark

webNewChapterOut.message: A chapter you have not read yet is out

webMakeShelf.message: Make a shelf of your own

webShelfStatusHint.message: What this shelf counts as: whether its series are watched for new chapters, and what they export as

webShelfRemoveHint.message: Remove this shelf: its series move to $1

webPageUnreadable.message: Could not read the page ($1). Fill it in by hand.

webClearHistoryConfirm.message: Delete every recorded read? Your library and bookmarks are not touched.

webMigrateSearching.message: Searching the new site for each series, this takes a while…

webExtensionSilent.message: The extension did not answer. Try again.

webSavedHereOnly.message: Saved here, but the account did not hear about it.

webTrackerRefusingFix.message: . Disconnecting and connecting again usually fixes it.

webSessionExpired.message: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

webOngoingHint.message: The series is still being published

trackerSendMyLibraryHint.message: Bring the tracker up to date with every bookmark you already have

trackerFetchAllHint.message: Read your chapter counts back from the tracker, so PanelFlow is not left behind what you have already read there. Your bookmarks are not touched.

trackerDisconnectConfirm.message:
Disconnect $1?

Nothing is removed from your tracker. PanelFlow forgets which series matched which, so reconnecting starts the matching over.

trackerNoMatch.message: $1 · no match found, pick it yourself

trackerRematchHint.message: Match this one again from scratch on the next chapter you read

webPopupBlocked.message: the browser blocked the window: allow popups for this site

webNoGunzip.message: this browser cannot unzip .gz: unzip the export first

webImportNeedsSource.message: give an AniList username or pick a MyAnimeList export

webPlanCounts.message: $1 to add · $2 to fill in · $3 already up to date

webMigrateTruncated.message: the search ran out of time, run it again for the rest

webPushBlocked.message: This browser is blocking notifications for PanelFlow. Allow them in the site settings

webPushOnHint.message: New chapters are announced even when PanelFlow is closed. Click to stop.

webPushOffHint.message: Be told about new chapters even when PanelFlow is closed

webPushExpiredOne.message: $1 subscription had expired and was removed

webPushExpiredN.message: $1 subscriptions had expired and were removed

webPushUnreachableOne.message: $1 browser could not be reached. Try again later

webPushUnreachableN.message: $1 browsers could not be reached. Try again later

webPushKeysHint.message: . If no notification appears, the server’s keys are wrong.

mobileLibraryEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Search for a series, open it, and add it from the reader.

mobileSearchPlaceholder.message: Search the web for a series

mobileSearchHint.message: PanelFlow does not host or index anything. This is a plain web search over your own words, and each result is checked to tell you whether Reader Mode will work there before you open it.

mobileSearchWebHint.message: PanelFlow hosts and indexes nothing: your words go out exactly as you typed them, as an ordinary web search. A result that turns out to be a chapter is recognised the moment it opens.
mobileSearchWebHint.description: Under the search box on the phone. Replaces mobileSearchHint there: the per-result compatibility check belonged to the server route this screen no longer calls.

mobileMediumManga.description: Filter chip on the phone shelf, beside Webtoons/Light novels/Anime.

mobileMediumAnime.description: Filter chip on the phone shelf, for entries whose medium is anime.

mobileLibraryCount.description: On the phone account screen, under the address. A fact to compare with another device when a sync looks incomplete.

mobileSearchFailed.message: The search did not come through. Try again, or see the results on the web.

mobileSearchNeedsAccount.message: The search could not run from this phone. Sign in (Settings › Account) to search through the PanelFlow server, or see the results on the web.

mobileVerdictUnlikely.message: Reader Mode probably will not work

mobileStatsSignedOut.message: Statistics live on your account: sign in on the Account tab to see them. What you read on this phone is kept below either way.

mobileNoBridge.message: Opened outside the app: there is no native bridge here, so there is no library to show.

webConsentLine.message: By continuing you accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.

legalNoticePage.description: File name of the legal notice page on the server, in this language. Not a sentence: leave as the file that exists.

legalPrivacyPage.description: File name of the privacy policy page on the server, in this language. Not a sentence.

legalTermsPage.description: File name of the terms of use page on the server, in this language. Not a sentence.

webLegalLede.message: Who runs PanelFlow, what it stores about you and why, and what using it means. No cookies, no tracking: the pages say exactly what the code does.

webDeleteAccountHint.message: Immediate and permanent: the account and everything in it (library, progress, history, connected trackers). Export first if you want to keep any of it.

webDeleteAccountLede.message: This deletes your account and everything attached to it, at once and for good. Type your password to confirm.

optionsConsentLine.message: By continuing you accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.

webChangeEmailHint.message: A confirmation link goes to the new address; nothing changes until it is opened.

webChangeEmailLede.message: Type the new address and your password. A link goes to the new address, and the account moves once it is opened.

mobileReportLede.message: Say what happened, in a sentence. The app's version, your phone, the last page and the app's last notes go with it, and the mail opens for you to send. Nothing leaves the phone until you do.

mobileSearchAllResults.message: See every result on the web

reportLedePc.message: Say what happened, in a sentence. The extension's version, your browser, the last page a chapter was found on and the extension's last notes go with it. Nothing leaves until you send the mail.

reportLedeWeb.message: Say what happened, in a sentence. The page, your browser and the time go with it, and the mail opens for you to send.

mobileOtaLede.message: Version $1, build $2. A fix can be published without a new version: this button looks for one and restarts the app if there is.

mobileMySitesLede.message: The sites your library comes from, and the ones you starred. Tap one to open it.

mobileMySitesEmpty.message: No sites yet. Type the address of the site you read on: when a page is a chapter, PanelFlow offers its reader. Add the series, and its site appears here.

err_backup_too_new.message: This backup was made by a newer version of PanelFlow. Update the app, then try again.

err_bad_email.message: This e-mail address is not valid.

err_bad_push_endpoint.message: This browser did not give a notification service PanelFlow can use.

err_bad_request.message: The request was refused. Check what you entered and try again.

err_bad_url.message: This address is not a web page (it must start with http or https).

err_category_exists.message: You already have a shelf with that name.

err_conflict.message: This was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload and try again.

err_email_taken.message: An account already exists with this address. Sign in instead.

err_forbidden.message: You are not allowed to do that.

err_import_invalid.message: This file is not an export PanelFlow can read.

err_link_expired.message: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.

err_mail_failed.message: The e-mail could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

err_mail_unavailable.message: This server cannot send e-mail, so this cannot be done here.

err_not_found.message: It no longer exists. It may have been removed on another device.

err_password_too_long.message: This password is too long (72 bytes at most).

err_push_none.message: No browser receives notifications for this account yet.

err_push_unavailable.message: Notifications are not available on this server.

err_rate_limited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

err_search_unavailable.message: Search is unavailable right now. Try again later.

err_server_error.message: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.

err_session_ended.message: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

err_site_blocked.message: The site refused to answer the PanelFlow server. Open it in your browser instead.

err_site_unreachable.message: The site did not answer. Check the address, or try again later.

err_too_large.message: This is too large to be sent.

err_too_long.message: One of the fields is too long.

err_too_many_items.message: That is more than PanelFlow can take at once.

err_tracker_expired.message: The connection to this service has expired. Connect it again.

err_tracker_failed.message: The service did not answer as expected. Try connecting it again.

err_tracker_not_linked.message: This series is not linked to that service.

err_tracker_unavailable.message: This service cannot be connected from this server.

err_unavailable.message: This is unavailable right now. Try again later.

err_upstream_failed.message: A service PanelFlow relies on did not answer. Try again later.

err_weak_password.message: The password must be at least 8 characters long.

accountPitch.message: Without an account, PanelFlow works entirely on this device. With one, your library follows you to your other devices, and your series are watched even while the device is off.

accountAgeRequired.message: To create an account, confirm that you are 15 or older.

localOwnerlessQuestion.message: This device already holds a library made without an account (series: $1). What should happen to it?

localSeparateHint.message: Kept separate, it comes back when you sign out.

localOtherOwnerQuestion.message: This device holds changes from $1 that were never sent. Sign in with that account to send them, or erase them to continue.

webMySitesEmpty.message: No sites yet. Open a chapter on the site where you read, with the extension or the app: when you add the series, its site appears here.

popupMySitesEmpty.message: No sites yet. Open a chapter on the site where you read: when you add the series, its site appears here, and a star keeps it at the top.

sitesStarNotSaved.message: The star could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

readerChapterUnavailable.message: This chapter could not be loaded: the site is not answering.

webMySitesLede.message: The sites your library comes from, and the ones you starred. Click one to open it.

actionResumeReread.description: Beside Continue, when the last chapter opened is behind the bookmark. $1 is that chapter, e.g. "Ch. 9".

readerBookmarkAhead.message: Your bookmark is further on ($1). Move it here?
readerBookmarkAhead.description: Toast when a chapter behind the bookmark opens (a reread). $1 is the bookmark’s chapter.

readerBookmarkMove.description: The toast’s button: sets the bookmark to the chapter being read.

readerBookmarkMoved.description: Said once the bookmark was moved to this chapter.

actionClose.description: Closes a sheet or a panel.

mobileWelcomeBody.message: Open a chapter on the site of your choice: PanelFlow shows it in a clean reader, remembers where you are, and tells you when the next one is out.

mobileCardHint.description: VoiceOver hint on a series card.

mobileCardDetails.description: VoiceOver action on a series card: opens its sheet.

mobileHistoryEmptyBody.message: The series you open show up here, most recent first, with the chapters out since.

mobileNotifyNewChapters.message: Tell me when a chapter is out

mobileNotifyHint.message: One notification per series when a check finds a new chapter. iOS asks for permission when you turn this on.

mobileNotifyBlocked.message: Notifications for PanelFlow are turned off in the iPhone’s Settings.

mobileUpdatesHint.message: Only while the app is open. With an account, the server keeps watching the sites it can reach and hands over what it found the next time you open the app.

mobileLanguageHint.message: Applies to the whole app and to the reader.

mobileReaderHint.message: Brightness, page gap and strip width are set in the reader itself, on the chapter you are reading (⚙).

mobileAdblockHint.message: The filter list ships with the app and is replaced by a newer one from the server when there is one. Allowing a domain covers its subdomains and every request its pages make.

mobilePasswordHint.message: We send a link to your address, and the link is what changes the password, so a device someone else left signed in cannot change it.

mobileVersionLine.description: Version and build number, as the App Store shows them.

popupNewTag.description: After the Continue button’s label when it opens a chapter never seen: "Ch. 247 · new".

libraryRemovedTitle.description: Toast after removing a series, with an Undo button beside it. $1 is the title.

popupDetailsOf.description: Name of the title on a popup card, which opens the series’ details. $1 is the title.

mediumChangeHint.message: Moving a series between reading and anime unlinks it from your trackers: it will be looked up there again.

webEpisodesAhead.message: The latest episode is $1 ahead of your bookmark

webNewEpisodeOut.message: An episode you have not watched yet is out

confirmRemoveBody.message: It will leave your library on all your devices. Add it again within 30 days and it comes back as it was.

confirmRemoveBodyLocal.message: It will leave this device’s library, with its progress.

mediumEmpty.message: No series of this type in this view.

confirmRemoveTracker.message: Also remove it from my $1 list
confirmRemoveTracker.description: Checkbox in the removal question, one per connected tracker. $1 is AniList or MyAnimeList.

confirmRemoveTrackerNote.message: This cannot be undone: its progress and score there are deleted.

confirmRemoveEverywhere.description: Phone app: the third button of the removal question, which also removes the series from the connected trackers.

confirmRemoveAlsoOn.message: It is also on your $1 list. “Remove everywhere” deletes it there too, and that cannot be undone.
confirmRemoveAlsoOn.description: Phone app: added to the removal question when a connected tracker has the series. $1 is one or more tracker names.

trackerRemoveNothing.message: Nothing to remove from your $1 list: it was not there.

trackerRemoveFailed.message: $1 could not remove it. Remove it on the $1 site.
